item.title: From Posts to Dialogues: Conversational and Contextual AI for Mental Health
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Information Processing & Management focuses on the application of conversational and contextual artificial intelligence technologies to mental health contexts. The issue addresses the intersection of AI systems capable of understanding dialogue and context with mental health support and intervention.
